name: energy-pareto-7b
_why: Traces the latency/energy trade-off by re-planning at several energy weights and measuring each resulting placement. Feeds the tokens/s versus watts Pareto figure.
_note: Run once per energy_weight of interest (0, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1), changing only that field, so each sweep directory holds one point of the front.
